"}, {"insert": {"image": "https://upload-os-bbs.hoyolab.com/upload/2026/09/06/0/291c8754193152bb6b6a77e4db5b252e_6406259753757334548.jpeg"}, "attributes": {"align": "img-center", "height": 1080, "width": 1920, "size": "0"}}, {"insert": "※ The limited S-Rank Agents and limited S-Rank W-Engines above will not become available in the Star-Studded Cast Stable Channel.

※ "Crimson Thirst" and "Neon Fantasies" are W-Engine Channels. The search count for guaranteed signals is cumulative across all W-Engine Channels, but is independent of and unaffected by other types of channels.
※ In the Exclusive Channel and W-Engine Channel, the S-Rank Signal Customization feature allows Proxies to select 6 S-Rank Agents/W-Engines as their customized Agents/W-Engines that will inherit the same data and drop rate rules as the non-featured S-Rank Agents/W-Engines in the Exclusive Channel/W-Engine Channel. If the S-Rank Signal obtained is not the featured S-Rank Agent/W-Engine, it is guaranteed to be one of the 6 selected S-Rank Agents/W-Engines.
※ In the Exclusive Channel and W-Engine Channel, the A-Rank Rate Up feature allows Proxies to select 2 A-Rank Agents/W-Engines as the current boosted A-Rank Agents/W-Engines that will inherit the same data and drop rate rules as the previous rate-up A-Rank Agents/W-Engines. If Proxies do not customize the rate-up Agents/W-Engines, the default A-Rank Agents/W-Engines of the current Exclusive Channel and W-Engine Channel will serve as the current rate-up A-Rank Agents/W-Engines.
※ For more information on Signal Searches, please press "Details" at the bottom-left of the search page.
